title: Pitter-Patter Pleatfin
statement: This palm-sized cuttlefish putters through tea-gold water on translucent, accordion-pleated fins, flashing little blue commas across its skin whenever something surprises it. Beneath a single arch of milky quartz, it patiently arranges bright pebbles into spirals on the charcoal sand—then steals one from the middle and spends the afternoon investigating the gap.
